after_start.name: {name}
after_start.text: *After school. I figure I'll look around campus a bit. I still don't know the layout. Walking down the hallway. My phone buzzes. — The group chat from my old school.*

after_kakao_1.name: {name}
after_kakao_1.text: *'yo sojeong's doing fine at her new school~' 'oh thank god lol' — I slip the phone back into my pocket.*

after_kakao_3.name: {name}
after_kakao_3.text: *...Thank god, huh. Really? If I'd just spoken up back then — Sojeong wouldn't have had to leave at all.*

after_kakao_5.name: {name}
after_kakao_5.text: *At this school — if I see something, I say it. No more looking the other way. Not this time.*

after_kakao_end.name: {name}
after_kakao_end.text: *I pull my phone back out and leave the group chat. Done. — I'm part of this school now.*

after_miss_dain_1.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_1.text: *Walking down the hallway when I hear heavy footsteps behind me.*

after_miss_dain_3.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_3.text: *I dodge to the side reflexively. Dain zooms past me. Running, then a sudden stop.*

after_miss_dain_5.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_5.text: Why are you sprinting in the hallway?

after_miss_dain_6.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_6.text: Late! Gotta hit the gym! — Catch you tomorrow, transfer kid!

after_miss_dain_7.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_7.text: *She waves and tears off. The girl's a hurricane. The name the teacher used earlier — Dain. And we're already past formalities.*

after_miss_yuna_1.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1.text: *Passing by the library when I notice a girl with red eyes walking while reading a book. The tattoos on her arms stand out — but the way she holds the book is surprisingly quiet.*

after_miss_yuna_2.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_2.text: *Yuna stares at the bookmark for a long moment. Like she's checking it for any creases.*

after_miss_yuna_4.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_4.text: *And she walks on. That's it. But — something about her stays in my mind.*

after_miss_seoyeon_1.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_1.text: *On my way out, I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after_miss_seoyeon_4.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_4.text: Lunch. I left the roof unlocked. Making me wait — bold move for a transfer student.

after_miss_seoyeon_6.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_6.text: ...I just went up for air. The door happened to be open.

after_miss_seoyeon_7.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_7.text: *She totally waited. — I feel kind of bad. And kind of amused, weirdly enough.*

after_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *I'm about to leave when my feet stop on their own. I keep thinking about the homeroom teacher — the way she watched everyone until the very end. I find myself standing in front of the faculty office. I knock and push the door open.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *The homeroom teacher. Her cardigan is even more rumpled than this morning. Looks like the day put her through the wringer.*

after_hidden_homeroom_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_4.text: You're not in trouble. — Just checking in on the new kid. How's it going so far?

after_hidden_homeroom_choice.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_choice.text: *Sounds like a routine check-in, but her eyes are genuinely watching me.*
choices: I'm okay. It's a better school than I expected.

after_homeroom_ok.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok.text: Yeah? — If anything comes up, swing by the office. Paperwork's a good excuse.

after_homeroom_ok_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_3.text: Better than expected, huh. — Weirdly reassuring to hear.

after_homeroom_ok_4.name: {name}
after_homeroom_ok_4.text: *She says it like it's just work talk, but that one came out a little more personal.*

after_homeroom_ok_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_5.text: Being perfect on day one will burn you out. Slack a little. — Off you go.

after_homeroom_ok_6.name: {name}
after_homeroom_ok_6.text: *She turns back toward her desk. I say a short goodbye and close the faculty office door, but the conversation lingers longer than I expected. — That wasn't just duty.*

after_homeroom_honest_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_1.text: Overwhelmed is normal. If you were cool and collected on your first day at a new school, that'd be the weird part.

after_homeroom_honest_2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_2.text: Have you ever transferred schools yourself, miss?

after_homeroom_honest_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_3.text: ...Something like that. I've been thrown into a new place without any warning.

after_homeroom_honest_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_4.text: If it gets rough, swing by the office. I'll treat you to a coffee — wait, you're a student. Juice, then.

after_homeroom_honest_5.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_5.text: A teacher buying drinks for a student?

after_homeroom_honest_choice2.name: {name}
choices: If you're worried, you can just say so.
I'll hold you to that juice, miss.

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.text: *Stifles a laugh.* Don't get your hopes up. It's from the vending machine.

after_homeroom_honest_9.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_9.text: If you can't settle in, I'll come drag you back myself.

after_homeroom_honest_10.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_10.text: *She disappears down the hallway. Long hair swaying behind her. — I watched her leave a little longer than I should have.*

after_homeroom_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the homeroom teacher in the hallway.*
after_homeroom_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The homeroom teacher stopped the transfer student to check on them. The student was honest about feeling overwhelmed. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
after_homeroom_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher hides warmth behind dry humor and deadpan delivery. Late 20s female teacher with brown wavy long hair and beige cardigan. She wraps her feelings in words like "work" and "professional concern." Former aspiring novelist.

after_hidden_nurse_intro.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro.text: *Walking down the hallway when — my head gets a little dizzy. First-day nerves, probably. There's a 'Nurse's Office' sign on one side of the hallway. A bit too dizzy to just push through.*

after_hidden_nurse_choice.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_choice.text: *I've been meeting people nonstop since this morning. Taking ten minutes to sit down wouldn't be that dramatic.*

after_nurse_skip.name: {name}
after_nurse_skip.text: *I've wandered around enough today. Let's go home and rest.*

after_nurse_enter_1.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_1.text: *I open the nurse's office door. A faint smell of antiseptic. White curtains, a white bed, a small desk. A woman is sitting at the desk. White coat, a stethoscope around her neck. Ash-purple bob cut neatly styled, watching me over her glasses with her chin propped on one hand. She was reading something — and looks up.*

after_nurse_enter_4.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4.text: You're the transfer kid, right? First day and already in the nurse's office. Rough one, huh? Let me see.

after_nurse_enter_5.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_5.text: *The nurse walks over. Her hand lands on my forehead.*

after_nurse_enter_6.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_6.text: No fever... could just be low blood pressure.

after_nurse_enter_7.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7.text: No fever, but... you need to unclench a bit. Here, lie down. Ten minutes.

after_nurse_enter_choice.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_choice.text: *I lie down on the bed. Through the curtain, I can see the nurse's back.*
choices: You look more tired than I do, miss.
This place is cozier than I expected

after_nurse_enter_choice_a.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_a.text: ...Sharp patient. I'm the one who should be worrying here.

after_nurse_enter_choice_b.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_b.text: Right? I like it here. — It's quiet, and if you ignore the smell of disinfectant, it's perfect.

after_nurse_enter_8.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8.text: Don't worry about being so polite in here. The nurse's office is a chill zone. That's kind of the whole point.

after_nurse_enter_10.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_10.text: That's ancient history. I like it here. At this school, the injuries are all small.

after_nurse_enter_11.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11.text: If you get dizzy again, come back. My door's always open. Just don't tough it out and come too late. That's what worries me.

after_nurse_enter_12.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_12.text: Next time you feel sick — actually, better if there isn't a next time.

after_nurse_freetalk.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the school nurse in the nurse's office.*
after_nurse_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The transfer student felt dizzy and visited the nurse's office. The nurse was playful but attentive. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
after_nurse_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is playful and teasing, but hides sincerity behind jokes. A former hospital nurse who burned out and moved to the school. She's quick to loosen the atmosphere so students can relax first.

after1_jealousy_seo_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_1.text: Hey, where'd you go during lunch? I went to the school store but you weren't there.

after1_jealousy_seo_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_2.text: *...What should I say. If I mention I was with Seoyeon, things might get weird.*

after1_jealousy_seo_3.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_3.text: ...The rooftop? Just the two of you?

after1_jealousy_seo_choice.name: {name}
choices: I ate on the rooftop with the president. (Honest)
I was just wandering around alone. (Lie)

after1_jealousy_seo_honest.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_honest.text: Yeah, she brought me there. Even had a packed lunch for two.

after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.text: ...I see? Could've told me, at least.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_lie.text: Nah, I was just wandering around by myself.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.text: Really? Alone? — Well, makes sense, it's your first day!

after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.text: *My fingertips catch on the corner of a paper in the side pocket of my bag. A folded note. I have no idea when it was slipped in there. Yuna's handwriting. 'I saw you on the rooftop at lunch. ...You and the council president looked close.' — Three dots at the end. She swallowed what she really wanted to say.*

after1_jealousy_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after1_jealousy_dain_1.text: I saw you at the school store with Dain during lunch. You adapt fast.

after1_jealousy_dain_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_dain_2.text: *She's smiling. Her fingers tap the clipboard. — The back of my neck goes hot. I look away.*

after1_jealousy_yuna_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_1.text: You went to the library at lunch? With Yuna?

after1_jealousy_yuna_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_2.text: ...She doesn't usually hang out with anyone, you know.

after_miss_dain_6_b.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_6_b.text: *She waves and runs off. — When she stopped short, her hand went to her right knee for half a second. She pulled it away immediately, but I saw it.*

after_miss_yuna_1_c.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1_c.text: *I pick it up and hold it out. Yuna stops and takes the bookmark.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3_b.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_3_b.text: You asked how I was settling in earlier. I just... kept thinking about that.

after_hidden_homeroom_3_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_3_c.text: Oh. So that's what this is about? — You did well to come. Sit for a minute.

after_homeroom_ok_b.name: {name}
after_homeroom_ok_b.text: *She slides the papers on her desk aside and looks back at me. The mood says this won't end with just one line. Apparently it wasn't just a passing pleasantry. She rests her hand on the back of the chair, pausing to choose her words.*

after_homeroom_honest_3_b.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_3_b.text: *Something similar? — Does that mean she did something other than teaching before?*

after_homeroom_honest_6_b.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_6_b.text: *'Educational concern.' — This person wraps things up too.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_b.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_b.text: *She laughed. — First time I've seen her laugh at a joke. She closes the attendance book and stands. She's halfway to the door when she turns back, like she just remembered something.*

after_homeroom_honest_9_b.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_9_b.text: *Earlier in class she said 'I memorize names on the first try.' — Saying it twice means something.*

after_hidden_nurse_intro_b.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro_b.text: *I stop in front of the door and take a breath. Just a short rest. I put my hand on the handle. Cold metal against my palm.*

after_nurse_enter_4_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4_c.text: Your uniform's brand-new stiff. And you've got that fresh-grass smell going. *Sniff sniff* Oh — cherry blossoms too. What a romantic transfer student.

after_nurse_enter_4_d.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_4_d.text: *Two sentences in and she's already steering the conversation. She stands and comes over — smooth, unhurried. Her hand lands on me and I tense up for no reason.*

after_nurse_enter_6_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_6_b.text: You can tell blood pressure from a forehead?

after_nurse_enter_7_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_7_b.text: *I lie down on the bed. The ceiling is white.*

after_nurse_enter_7_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7_c.text: *Pulling the curtain halfway* Want some water? Or something warm?

after_nurse_enter_8_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8_c.text: *Handing over a cup of water* Right, I'm a teacher. But in here, you being comfortable comes first.

after_nurse_enter_8_d.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_8_d.text: *She says it playfully, but a bit of the tension lifts. I drink the water and look around the nurse's office. A small potted plant sits in one corner.*

after_nurse_enter_9_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_9_c.text: Yeah, rosemary. — I've had it since my hospital days.

after_nurse_enter_9_e.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_9_e.text: *The nurse pauses for a moment. Then smiles.*

after_nurse_enter_10_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_10_b.text: *'Just minor injuries.' — There's relief in those words. Ten minutes pass. I get up.*

after_nurse_enter_10_c.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_10_c.text: Thank you. I feel a bit better.

after_nurse_enter_11_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_c.text: *Narrowing her eyes* If you're feeling bad and keep pushing through it, of course I'm going to worry. That's literally why I'm here.

after_nurse_enter_11_d.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_d.text: *She says it casually, but the last part lands with unexpected weight.*

after_nurse_enter_11_e.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_e.text: *The nurse gives a small shrug, and the easy smile slips back into place.*

after_nurse_enter_11_f.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_f.text: That thing you said earlier — thanks for worrying about me. First time I've heard that from a patient.

after_nurse_enter_11_g.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_g.text: *She looks a little unused to having concern directed back at her. — She seems more familiar with being the one who takes care of people.*

after_nurse_enter_11_h.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_h.text: You said it was cozy earlier? — Hearing that actually made me happy.

after_nurse_enter_11_j.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_j.text: *I'm heading out of the nurse's office when — from behind me.*

after_nurse_enter_12_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_12_b.text: *I wave goodbye with a light laugh. I notice a band-aid on the back of her hand. — A strange nurse's office. The good kind of strange.*
